description:
An engineering change order (ECO) requires updating the T8 lead screw housing bracket. The original design uses a T8 lead screw and M4 mounting bolts. You need to modify the design for a larger 16mm shaft bushing and M5 mounting bolts.

Open the existing model at '~/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_housing_bracket.FCStd'.

Requirements:
1. Change the large central bore diameter to exactly 16.0 mm.
2. Change the four (4) base mounting hole diameters to 5.5 mm (clearance for M5).
3. Do not modify the overall outer dimensions of the bracket.

Save the modified design as '~/Documents/FreeCAD/modified_housing.FCStd'.
